mapper.select: SELECT FROM detection_policy ORDER BY policy_type,id DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT policy_type FROM detection_policy_lock WHERE policy_type=#{type} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM detection_policy WHERE policy_type=#{type} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM detection_policy WHERE policy_type=#{type} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE detection_policy SET status='pending',submitted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft'
UPDATE detection_policy SET status=#{status},reviewed_by=#{actor},reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),decision_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending' AND created_by<>#{actor}
UPDATE detection_policy SET status='retired',retired_by=#{actor},retired_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('draft','pending','active')
